verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke documents a dedicated data analytics, protection and privacy practice covering compliant data commercialisation, privacy/data protection law across 'Europe's trickiest jurisdictions,' and long-standing partner experience since the 1990s, plus a related cyber-incident practice. However, evidence doesn't explicitly name GDPR, CCPA, or DPDP Act, nor detail India-specific privacy counsel despite having an India office presence. Missing for 10: explicit mention of specific statutes (GDPR/CCPA/DPDP), jurisdiction-specific privacy compliance case studies, and independent corroboration of privacy practice depth.
